name: Brinner — Scrambled Eggs, Waffles, and Sausage
description: The reliable low-effort weeknight. Soft-scrambled eggs, waffles, sausage links, and whatever fruit is in the house.
instructions: Start the sausage in a cold skillet over medium heat with a splash of water. Cover and cook 5 minutes, then uncover and brown all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Toast the waffles and hold them on a sheet pan in a 200°F oven so nothing has to be eaten cold.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until completely uniform — no streaks of white left.
Melt 2 Tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-LOW. Pour in the eggs and wait until the edges just start to set.
Push the eggs slowly from the edges toward the center with a rubber spatula, forming big soft folds. Keep the heat low and keep moving.
Pull them off the heat when they still look slightly underdone — they finish cooking in the pan. Stir in the last Tbsp of butter.
Serve immediately with the waffles, sausage, syrup, and fruit.
tips: Low and slow is the only trick to scrambled eggs. High heat makes them squeaky and weeping.
Taking them off underdone feels wrong the first few times and is right every time.
Cut the fruit while the sausage cooks — it's the only step that has to happen and gets forgotten.
